summary.possible_issue: A desktop client can continue serializing profile.displayName after mobile decoding support changes, leaving incompatible cached or transferred profile data when the preservation window ends.
summary.prevention: Preserve the field for one release and verify or retire both the mobile decoder and desktop serializer before that release window expires.
